name: AwoSign
author: AwoScan

sections.description:
AwoSign 2.2 Global is an all-in-one corporate identity, staff credential, and billing card studio for WordPress with native support for 10 Global Languages (TR, EN, 中文 Chinese, العربية Arabic RTL, DE, RU, ES, FR, 日本語 Japanese, 한국어 Korean) and Bilingual (Dual-Language) Business Cards. Enter your company branding and staff list once, and generate 5 professional outputs directly inside WP Admin -> AwoSign:

  • 1. Multi-Template HTML Email Signatures (600 px): Switch between Classic Left Logo, Modern Compact Bar, and Corporate Header Banner + QR table layouts compatible with Gmail, Outlook, and Apple Mail.
  • 2. Digital Business Card & UTF-8 vCard 3.0 (540 px & [awosign]): Share interactive digital contact cards with one-click .vcf contact download, high-resolution PNG export, and WhatsApp sharing.
  • 3. Printable Horizontal Business Cards (85 × 55 mm & A4 10-Up in 10 Languages + Bilingual Mode): Design single-language or Bilingual (Turkish + Chinese 中文, Turkish + Arabic العربية, English + Chinese) business cards with automatic Right-to-Left (RTL) layout for Arabic, full UTF-8 multibyte QR code encoding, 300 PPI or 600 DPI print-shop master PNGs (with 3 mm bleed and corner crop marks), and 10 cards per A4 sheet (2×5 grid).
  • 4. Vertical CR80 Staff & Visitor ID Badges (54 × 86 mm & [awobadge]): Design vertical PVC lanyard badges with staff portrait photo (or automatic initials avatar), department, staff ID number, blood type, role band, back-side QR code, HSE emergency contact, CSV bulk staff import, and A4 9-up badge sheet printing.
  • 5. Official Company Invoice & Bank / IBAN Cards ([awocard] & WooCommerce BACS): Create official billing cards (Tax Office, Tax ID / VKN, MERSIS, KEP) and multi-currency Bank / IBAN / SWIFT cards with offline QR codes, one-click IBAN copy buttons, and optional automatic display on the WooCommerce Bank Transfer (BACS) thank-you page.

Shortcodes Included

  • [awosign id="prof_1"] — Embeds the selected staff member’s Digital Contact Card & vCard download button.
  • [awobadge id="prof_1"] (or [awosign type="badge" id="prof_1"]) — Embeds the vertical CR80 (54 × 86 mm) Front & Back Staff ID Badge.
  • [awocard] (or [awosign type="billing"]) — Embeds the Company Invoice Details Card and Bank / IBAN Cards with one-click copy buttons (mode="all|invoice|bank").

Privacy, Personal Data & Offline Architecture (GDPR / KVKK)

  • 100% Local QR & Canvas Engine: AwoSign makes zero automatic external HTTP requests. QR codes are generated locally in the browser using the bundled MIT-licensed qrcode-generator library (assets/qrcode.js) with full UTF-8 multibyte encoding.
  • Privacy-by-Default Staff ID Badges ([awobadge]): Sensitive health information (Blood Type) and personal phone numbers are masked/hidden by default on public [awobadge] shortcodes unless an administrator explicitly passes show_blood="1" or show_phone="1".
  • WordPress Core Privacy Tools Integration: Integrates with Tools -> Export Personal Data and Tools -> Erase Personal Data (wp_privacy_personal_data_exporters and wp_privacy_personal_data_erasers) so staff profiles can be exported or erased by email address.

Free vs. PRO Edition

  • AwoSign Free (Included 100% Locally): 1 Staff Profile, 1 Bank / IBAN Account, Turkish & English card outputs, 300 PPI Standard PNG export, UTF-8 vCard 3.0 (.vcf), 3 HTML Email Signature templates, and [awosign], [awobadge], [awocard] shortcodes.
  • AwoSign PRO & AWO Suite Master PRO (Optional Upgrade): Unlimited staff profiles, CSV bulk staff import, 10 Global Languages (Chinese 中文, Arabic العربية RTL, DE, RU, ES, FR, JA, KO) + Bilingual trade fair cards, multi-currency Bank / IBAN wallet, 600 DPI Print-Shop Master PNGs with 3 mm bleed and corner crop marks, and automatic WooCommerce Bank Transfer (BACS) thank-you page IBAN display. One Polar.sh PRO key also works across the companion Web & Desktop studio at https://awosign.awoscan.com.

External Services

  • 100% Offline Default Operation: By default in Free mode, AwoSign makes zero external HTTP requests. All QR codes and Canvas exports are generated locally in your browser.
  • Optional AWO-Guard / Polar.sh PRO License Verification (https://awosign.awoscan.com): Only when a site administrator explicitly enters a PRO license key and clicks “Activate PRO” inside WP Admin -> AwoSign, the plugin sends a one-time HTTPS POST request to https://awosign.awoscan.com/api/license/activate containing the license key, site domain, and company name/tax ID to issue a signed domain lease token.
    • Service Provider: AwoScan / AwoSign Cloud Portal (https://awosign.awoscan.com) & Polar Software, Inc. (https://polar.sh)
    • Terms & Privacy Policy: https://awoscan.com/privacy and https://polar.sh/legal/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the awosign folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install directly via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate AwoSign through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open AwoSign in the WordPress admin sidebar to manage staff profiles, badges, bank IBAN accounts, and print layouts.
sections.faq:
Can I create Chinese (中文), Arabic (العربية RTL), or Bilingual (dual-language) business cards?

Yes. AwoSign 2.1 includes one-click language presets for 10 global languages (TR, EN, 中文, العربية RTL, DE, RU, ES, FR, 日本語, 한국어) as well as optional secondary fields (Company 2nd Language, Name 2nd Language, Title 2nd Language) so both scripts appear together on your 85×55 mm print cards, digital vCards, email signatures, and CR80 badges.

Can I import multiple staff members at once for signatures and ID badges?

Yes. Use the CSV Bulk Import button in the top staff bar to import multiple staff profiles (Name, Title, Department, StaffNo, BloodType, Role, Phone, Email) in a single click.

How do I display company invoice details and IBAN cards on my Contact or Payment page?

Paste [awocard] (or [awosign type="billing"]) into any page or post, or enable the WooCommerce Bank Transfer (BACS) checkbox in the editor to display your IBAN cards automatically after checkout.
sections.changelog:
2.2.0

  • Free + PRO Tier Architecture & AWO-Guard v1.0 Licensing: Added in-dashboard Polar.sh PRO license activation (AWO-SIGN-... and AWO-SUITE-... Master Bundle support) with domain lease verification and one-click domain unbinding.
  • Cross-Platform Workspace Compatibility: Synchronized schema with the companion Web, Desktop PWA, and Mobile Studio at https://awosign.awoscan.com.
  • External Services Disclosure: Documented optional PRO license activation endpoint in readme.txt per WordPress.org Plugin Directory guidelines while keeping all Free features 100% offline.

2.1.0

  • Global 10-Language & Bilingual Business Card Studio: Added native card localization for Turkish (tr), English (en), Chinese (zh 中文), Arabic (ar العربية with automatic Right-to-Left RTL layout), German (de), Russian (ru), Spanish (es), French (fr), Japanese (ja 日本語), and Korean (ko 한국어).
  • Bilingual (Dual-Language) Fields & 1-Click Global Presets: Added companyAlt, personAlt, and jobAlt fields plus 10 one-click presets (including TR + Chinese 中文 and TR + Arabic العربية bilingual trade cards).
  • Full UTF-8 Multibyte QR & 600 DPI RTL Canvas Engine: Activated qrcode.stringToBytesFuncs['UTF-8'] so Chinese, Arabic, Turkish, Cyrillic, Japanese, and Korean vCards encode without character corruption, and upgraded the 300 PPI / 600 DPI Canvas PNG exporters for RTL and bilingual typography.

2.0.0

  • Major All-in-One Corporate Identity Upgrade: Integrated AwoBadge (Vertical CR80 54 × 86 mm Staff & Visitor ID Badge Studio) and AwoCard (Official Company Invoice & Multi-Currency Bank / IBAN Cards with WooCommerce BACS integration).
  • Added [awobadge] and [awocard] shortcodes alongside [awosign].

1.3.0

  • Added multi-staff profile manager with WordPress database persistence (wp_options via Nonce-verified AJAX).
  • Added [awosign id="prof_1"] frontend shortcode for embedding interactive digital contact cards.
  • Added 3 email signature templates and 600 DPI print-shop master PNG export with 3 mm bleed and corner crop marks.

1.0.1

  • Initial release on WordPress.org.
